Fake state is caller supplied, not durable or uncloneable. Preserve exact exclusive publication/root identity/claim refusal/error order and all consumed records; never authorize resets, old grants or a new attempt merely by changing IDs.

Preserve every finite/regression/owner/expired-boundary refusal and all original clock origins; no new stopwatch/timer reset, subtraction across epochs, added window or guarantee of full role windows.
Preserve fresh proof/original/candidate/fresh replay roles, handle-before-release and all receipt/source joins. Never substitute old proof, partial gradients or labels for fresh execution.

Source code does not establish current target quiescence. Future preflight is target work requiring new review/authority; sampled GPU/observed tree checks are not continuous exclusivity or exhaustive physical ownership proof.

Preserve failure ownership from first new allocation/effect, bounded primary/cause diagnostics and no clock handoff/collection while idle is unconfirmed. A closed descriptor alone is not death; no blind remote cleanup/retry.

Any future new fallible validation/publication changes reachable errors unless fully reviewed. Preserve every original read/hash/scan/fsync/check and partial state/order; no assumed harmless metadata work or source bridge/inverse shortcut.

The fake dictionary is not the full resource domain or physical enforcement. All original caps/math/native/optimizer/backward/RNG/modes/immutable copies/EVERY fresh hash/ordered state_digest and financial holds stay fixed; no fit or benefit claim.

Actual executable/library digests, build/source/ABI/backend/provider joins remain unavailable in the reviewed corpus. This static review adds no target query, inventory, library import or new observation.
